primary_metric: QLIKE (lower is better); differences are model minus baseline, so negative favours the model
weighting: every month counts equally; examples within a month count equally
interval: 95 percent moving-block bootstrap over months, block 12 months (sensitivity (3, 6, 12, 24))
trimmed_view: RETROSPECTIVE: drops examples whose answer is above the 99.9% point of all test answers
